text: A fixed point x* of a 1D ODE dx/dt = f(x) is asymptotically stable if and only if:
explanation: f(x*) = 0 is necessary (but not sufficient) for x* to be a fixed point. Asymptotic stability requires that small perturbations decay back to x*, which by linearisation holds when f'(x*) < 0 — the derivative is negative, so the flow pushes trajectories back toward x*. When f'(x*) > 0 the fixed point is unstable; when it equals 0 the linearisation is inconclusive.
